question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**accumulated**" means gathered together or acquired an increasing number or quantity over time. (जमा किया हुआ)
 
• Example: Over the years, she **accumulated** a significant amount of wealth.
 
• In the context of the passage,** "accumulated"** fits best as people were counting the cash they had gathered or collected over the years.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1** i.e. 'accumulated'.

**Complete Sentence:** *People started counting the cash they had accumulated__ for years legally or illegally.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Distributed (वितरित)**: means to give shares of something; to pass out. 

 
 
• **Example:** The charity distributed food and clothing to the needy.
 
 
 
• **Withdrawn (निकाला हुआ)**: means taken out of a place or position. 
 
 
• **Example:** He has withdrawn all his savings from the bank.
 
 
 
• **Dispersed (विखरित)**: means distributed or spread over a wide area. 
 
 
• **Example:** The crowd dispersed after the rally ended.
